newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland invites bids for Iskra ball-bearings firm.
newsitem.headline: Poland invites bids for Iskra ball-bearings firm.

text.p: The Polish treasury ministry, the former privatisation ministry, is inviting bids for up to 80 percent of the Fabryka Lozysk Tocznych Iskra SA, the ministry said in a Thursday newspaper advertisement.
It said the deadline for bids for no less than 10 percent of the firm was March 7. Iskra, which employes 3,500 people, is Poland's largest ball-bearings maker and the only producer of spark plugs.
Iskra's employees will get 15 percent of the shares for free and the treasury will retain five percent for restitution claims.
Pawel Roszkowski of the firm TDI advising the ministry on the sale told Reuters that Iskra had annual sales of about $60 million, and was profitable, but could not yet give its net result for 1996.
